content: SA is now 1.566, the best I have seen, but LogP 4.08 and three aromatic rings keep QED at 0.761. Step 2 is the fluorine. Atom 14 is the aromatic CH ortho to atom 6, which carries the arylamine, and meta to atom 3, which carries the anilide - the exact substitution pattern of my leader. The ring CH hydrogen is implicit so the new bond just displaces it.
